reflection: Across rounds, nearly every factor helped in 2023 and 2025 but hurt in 2022 and 2024, so gains look regime-dependent (high-vol years vs trending years differ). Volume-based peer info (msft_volume_surge) was the only one helping both models. Unsigned or ratio-type factors failed; near-copies of existing factors get rejected. I will try volume-based variants, volatility-adjusted relative moves (to stabilize across regimes), and new cross-asset features like NVDA/QQQ volume and range-based market stress.

lessons.name: aapl_gap_sign_vs_prev_close
lessons.lesson: Sign of the relative gap was constant/missing in some quarter because the formula degenerated, so it was unusable and sign-only transformations of gaps are fragile.

lessons.name: aapl_close_position_zscore_5d
lessons.lesson: Z-scoring a bounded intraday position over 5 days mostly added noise and removed the level information that gave the small LR gain.

lessons.name: aapl_close_vs_20d_high
lessons.lesson: It is nearly the same as distance to the 20d mean, so it carried no new information and shared its regime-flipping behavior.

lessons.name: qqq_close_to_ma20
lessons.lesson: QQQ trend vs MA is largely redundant with QQQ 5d return and its mean-reversion/momentum sign flips between 2022 bear and other years.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_qqq_cum_5d
lessons.lesson: Relative 5d performance overlaps with Apple's own 5d momentum and its sign flips across regimes, helping only in 2023 and 2025.

lessons.name: msft_volume_surge
lessons.lesson: Unusual MSFT volume is a market-attention proxy that carried slightly new information helping both models, but its effect was unstable in 2022 and 2024.

factors.name: msft_volume_surge_signed
factors.hypothesis: Volume surge without direction was unstable (2022, 2024); signing it by MSFT's return separates high-volume selling from buying, which should transfer to Apple's next move.

factors.name: aapl_minus_qqq_5d_volscaled
factors.hypothesis: The raw relative move failed in 2024 when vol was low and 2022 when high; scaling by Apple's 20d vol makes it comparable across regimes.

factors.name: nvda_volume_surge
factors.hypothesis: Tech-sector risk appetite shows in NVDA turnover; abnormal NVDA volume may signal sector stress that precedes Apple moves.

factors.name: qqq_range_vs_aapl_range
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low), QQQ_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close))
factors.hypothesis: When Apple's intraday range is wide relative to the market's, Apple-specific noise is high and tends to mean-revert next day.

factors.name: aapl_volume_surge_signed
factors.hypothesis: Pairs MSFT volume attention with Apple's own volume-confirmed direction; high-volume up/down days carry continuation or exhaustion information different from the peer volume signal.

factors.name: aapl_close_position_vs_qqq_position
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_Close, AAPL_Low), subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low)), safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_Close, QQQ_Low), subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low)))
factors.hypothesis: Apple's close location relative to the market's close location removes the market-wide component of the intraday signal, complementing the raw Apple position that flipped sign by regime.
